text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As their expedition continues, many members of the crew
grow weary of attending to the same tasks day in and day out,
and a sense of lethargy begins to hang in the air of the firelit camp.
text_block_list.orig_text:
開拓が進む中、何日間も同じ作業の繰り返しに飽きた者たちが現れ、
篝火に照らされたキャンプには疲労と倦怠感が蔓延しはじめていた。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there today! Didja find anything?
I wish I could've gone with you, but the investi...
uh, I mean, my chores have gotta take priority!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日もお仕事お疲れ様ッス！　
何か見つかったッスか？
自分も一緒に行きたいッスけど
調査の任務……
じゃなくて
雑用が多くて
ついていけないッスよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
...! That lady looking this way is a dragongirl too, right?
Everyone calls her \"boss,\" so she's gotta be the guildmaster.
One of the gangsters told me her actual name is "Homare."
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
こっちを見てるあの人も
ドラゴン族ッスよね？
ボス、
って呼ばれてたし
ギルドマスターさんのはずッス。
ギャングの人に聞いたッスけど、
ホマレさん、
って名前らしいッス。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Uergh. She doesn't [i]look[/i] like old Christina,
but she gives me the same vibe...
Somehow she seems way more dangerous than the other two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
クリスティーナおばさんとは全然違うのに、
似たような感じがするッス……
なんか
他の二人と違って
ヤバい感じがするッスよ……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: She's got such blatant hidden depths, it's just way too creepy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
底が知れないというか、
不気味すぎですよアレは。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And that smile... It never reaches her eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ッス……
それにあの人、
絶対笑ってないッスよ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: How's anyone supposed to have a clue what she's thinking?
text_block_list.orig_text: ほんと何考えてるかぜーんぜん分からないです……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely.
You should hear the things she's put me through...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったくですよ……
どれだけひどい目に遭わされたか……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Th-that bad, huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなにッスか……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Even with her eyes closed, her gaze could kill.
Trust me, you don't want to see her open them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
目をつぶってるのにあの迫力です。
見開いたらあんなもんじゃねえですよ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Wait—waghhhh?! Wh-why are you here?!
Don't just slip into our private conversation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、ふわわっ！？　
な、
なにやってるッス！
会話に自然に交ざらないでほしいッス！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: H-hah! As if a brat like you could keep secrets from me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ、
へんっ！　
ガキンチョが隠し事なんて十年早いです！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hold up... Is she beckoning in our direction?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんか
こっちに手招きしてるッス……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Pyeughh?!
I-I'm sure it must be you she's calling for...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴうぅっ！？
あ、
あれはきっと
おまえを呼んでるですよ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Her lips are moving too.
Lemme see. \"I... o... i…\" \"I... no... ri…\"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
口うごかしてるッスね。
ええと……
いーおーいー、
いーのーりー……？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
N-no, look again.
I think she's saying \"Ma... tsu... ri.\"
I'm sure of it... It's the only explanation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
ちがうです……
あれは
マーツーリー
ですよ……
きっとそうです……
そうにちがいないです……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like it to me...
Oh, now she's raised her fingers. Is she doing a countdown?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちがうと思うッスけどねえー
あ、
なんか指を立てて……
数をカウントしてるッスか？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Pyeughhh...!
Urkk... Wh-why? How did it come to this?!
Th-this is... It's all your fault, you hear?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴゃうぅぅ……！
うう……
なんで、
どうしてこんなことに……
おまえの！　
おまえのせいですよーー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I think you brought it on yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text: 明らかに自業自得ッス……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Y-you'll regret this someday!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おぼえてろですーーー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Even while protesting, she actually ran over to see the boss...
Seems like... a tough life in that guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ言いながら
結局ボスさんのところに行っちゃったッスね……
なんか……
こっちのギルドって大変ッス……

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: The hell'd you just say?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだとてめぇ！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! You try'na pick a fight?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁん！　
けんか売ってんのかぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: You better believe it!
text_block_list.orig_text: 上等だオラァ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
N-now they're infighting too?!
Tough isn't the half of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
今度はけんかッスか！？
ほんとに大変ッスよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Now listen, you two. What's all this about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
キミたちさ、
いったいなにやってんの。

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: Wha... Kaya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ、
カヤさん？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Oh, phew. I'm sure Kaya'll be able to put a stop to this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった……
カヤさんならきっと
けんかを止めてくれるッス！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Who was it?
text_block_list.orig_text: どっち？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: L-look, he's the one in the wrong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
悪いのはアイツで……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I don't care who's wrong. Which one of you started the fight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その辺はどうでもいいよ。
先にケンカ売ったのはどっち？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: It was him! He came up and started accusing me of stealing stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつですよ！　
こいつが
俺が盗んだだのと言いがかり付けてきて！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: If you didn't steal it, who the hell did?!
text_block_list.orig_text: おめえが盗った以外にありえねえんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... All right, got it! Listen.
You picked a fight with him, so I'll take you up on it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
よし分かった！　
いいか？
キミがコイツに売ったケンカ、
それはオレが買う。

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
いや
それは……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
And you accepted his fight, so I'll accept it from you.
That way everyone's even. We clear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んで、
キミが買ったケンカを、
今度はオレに売る。
これで差し引き０。
オッケー？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: W-well, I guess that does... make sense...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まあ
確かにそうなる
かな……？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Then there's no need for you to fight each other. Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあキミらがケンカする必要はなくなった。
いい？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, sure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
まあ……

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: If you say so, Kaya...
text_block_list.orig_text: カヤさんがそう言うなら……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Amazing! She stopped the fight in seconds flat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいッス！　
あっというまにけんかを止めたッス！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Great! You can both come at me together, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
じゃあ二人まとめてでいいぜ。

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: はい？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
The fights you two picked both belong to me now, see?
So obviously this ain't over until we've settled 'em, is it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミら二人のケンカ、
オレが売って、
買ったよな……？
だったらさあ、
その分キッチリ
精算しなきゃなんねえだろうが……！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! Wait—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ……
まっ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
The boss said anyone who beats me in a fight
gets promoted on the spot, didn't she?
And I'm letting you take me two-on-one! So let's see your best shot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボスも
オレにタイマンで勝てたら幹部昇進
って言っただろ？
二人同時でいいって言ってんだ！　
ほら、
かかってこいよ！！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: Arghhh... If that's how it's gonna be...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそぉ……
そういうことなら！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: W-we've got no choice! Yaarghh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いくしかねえ！！　
オラァ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
That's more like it! Just what I like to see!
I've been itching for a fight, so try to keep me entertained! Yaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいぜいいぜ！　
そうこなくっちゃなぁっ！！
久々のケンカだ、
ちったぁ楽しませろよテメェら！　
オラァァッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh... Somehow it ended up worse than it started.
I thought Kaya was nice, but she can be super scary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あわわ……
なんか余計にひどいことになってるッスよ。
優しい人かと思ったのに
めちゃくちゃ怖いッス……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-if you saw it coming, couldn't you try to stop her?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かってたなら止めてほしいッスよぉ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
All of this commotion is perfect for investigating.
Matsuri's with him, so she should be safe for the moment...
Aha! Found them. That's Inori and Homare...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これくらい騒々しい方が
調査しやすくて助かるね。
マツリちゃんには
あの人がついてるから大丈夫だろうし……
おっと、
見つけた。
イノリさんとホマレさんだ……

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Oh, Inori~? Is something wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イノリちゃ～ん？　
どうかした？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-wh-why would things be wrong?
I mean, it was that brat Matsuri who said those things, not me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
ななななんでもないですよ？
というかあれは
あのマツリってガキンチョが言ってたことで……！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Said what, exactly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？　
何の話？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're not mad 'cause of the stuff we were saying about you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ボスの陰口が聞こえて
怒ってたんじゃないんです？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I wouldn't call you over here just for that!
Now, before you tell me all about that conversation in detail...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
そんなことでわざわざ呼んだわけじゃないよ？
……まあ、
その話は
またあとでゆっくり聞かせてもらうとして～

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Eurghh! Oh noooo! I dug my own grave!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひい！　
しまったぁ！　
墓穴をほったです！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
Inori... You're sensitive to these things, so I want your opinion.
Since we set up camp here, have you felt like we're being watched?
This little one... Largo has been ever so restless the whole time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イノリちゃんは
結構こういうの鋭いと思うから
聞くんだけどー……
ここにキャンプを張ってから、
誰かに見られてる気がしない？
この子……
ラーゴもずっと、
落ち着きがないんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Largo
text_block_list.text: Growrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: They've noticed my eyes on them...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 私の監視が気付かれてる……？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I don't really know.
Are you sure it's not just wild animals?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
よく分かんないですね。
野生動物とかじゃないです？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think I'm imagining things...
But let's be careful, just in case.
It could be someone sneaky enough to fool even you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の気のせいだったらいいんだけど……
一応、
気を付けておいてね。
イノリちゃんでも気付かないくらいの
相手かもしれないし☆

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: D-don't say scary things like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
怖いこと言うなですよ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's leave it at that for today.
Try not to oversleep tomorrow morning. Nighty-night~! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ今日は
これくらいにしておきましょうか。
明日の調査に寝過ごさないようにね。
おやすみ～☆

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
She said her spiel and ran off...
*sigh* Guess I'd better head to bed.
Let me just find Kaya-P first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
言うだけ言って行っちゃったですよ。
はあ、
もう今日は寝るしかないです。
そうと決まればカヤぴぃを探して……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad our cover doesn't seem to be blown, at least...
But Homare's words are concerning.
Is there a third party keeping watch on all of us...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちのことが気付かれたわけじゃあなくてよかったけど……
ホマレさんの言ってたことも気になるな。
私たち以外にも
誰かが監視している……？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeughh?! Think you can bump into [i]me,[/i] do you?!
Try looking where you're—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃううぅ！？　
なにぶつかってきてんですか！
よそ見してんじゃ……

text_block_list.text: Mrghhh?
text_block_list.orig_text: もご？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-wh... What the heck is thiiiiiis?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
な……
なんじゃこりゃあ～
です～！！！

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: What's that?!
text_block_list.orig_text: あれは！？

text_block_list.text: MGRUOOOHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐおもももー！？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: The heck?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだあ！？

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: I-it's a fire!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
火事だぁ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
A fire?! We're in the middle of a fight!
This isn't the time for fires!
text_block_list.orig_text:
火事だぁ？　
今はケンカ中だぞ！
それどころじゃねえだろうが！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 1
text_block_list.text: I-I think the fire is more urgent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それどころじゃあるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Gangster 2
text_block_list.text: H-hey... What's that freaky shadow...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おい……
なんだよ、
あの影……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Quit getting distracted! Can't you try to face me like men?!
Ugh, what exactly is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よそ見してんじゃねえ！　
ケンカの途中だって言ってんだろ！！
ったく
いったいなにが……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Wahhh?! Wh-what's going on?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃあ？　
な、
なんなんスか！？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Whoa there. You OK, Matsuri?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
大丈夫かマツリ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒッ……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Guess that scene was a bit much for a kid.
Sorry, I didn't mean to scare ya...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
子供には刺激強すぎたかもしれないな。
悪いな、
怖がらせちまって……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for the... What now?
Wait. Whoa, whoa, whoa...!
Could this actually be...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ……
さっきから
って、
オイオイオイオイ……
コイツは、
まさか……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The silhouette that faced them before the firelight
looked exactly like that of a winged dragon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
炎の照りかえしにより映しだされたシルエットは
羽根を広げた竜の姿そのものだった。

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: The~re you are! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
……見～
つけ
た☆
